name: Moreno Valley Emerging Leaders' Council (ELC)
what_you_do: Join the city's youth council. You learn how local government works, do community service and tell the City Council what young people need.
who_can_apply: High school and college students. The City Council appoints members. The page does not list an age range, so ask city staff.
duration: Terms end May 31, 2027 for current seats. The council meets the fourth Monday of each month at 6 pm.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. As of Oct 28, 2026, the page lists 3 open member seats, open alternate seats and 25 open member-at-large spots.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Program Application Form linked on the ELC page. The City Council makes the appointments.
notes: Meetings are at the Conference and Recreation Center, 14075 Frederick Street. The council has 9 members and 2 alternates. It started in 2014. City staff on the page can answer questions.
